connections.why: Defining quantities leads into distinguishing scalars from vectors and resolving them
Handling uncertainties and graphs is exactly what the written practical paper assesses
The same techniques and analysis underpin both the exam and the hands-on endorsement
Resolving vectors is essential for two-dimensional motion and projectiles
Forces are vectors, so equilibrium needs vector addition and resolution
Kinematics describes motion that Newton's laws then explain through forces
Resultant forces from free-body analysis drive Newton's second law
Displacement and velocity feed directly into work done and kinetic energy
Tension and compression forces deform materials, leading to Hooke's law
Elastic strain energy is the work stored in a stretched material
Current and Kirchhoff's first law are the foundation for analysing circuits
Resistance and EMF combine in series and parallel circuit analysis
Wave behaviour of light contrasts with the photon model in wave-particle duality
Centripetal force is just Newton's second law applied to circular paths
Energy conservation extends to internal energy, heating and the gas laws
The mathematics of circular motion underpins simple harmonic motion
Newton's law of gravitation provides the centripetal force for orbits
Orbital motion combines circular motion with gravitational attraction
Gravitational fields govern stellar structure, orbits and the dynamics of the universe
The Doppler effect and spectra of starlight rely on wave behaviour
Exponential discharge of a capacitor mirrors the decay seen in damped oscillations
Charging and discharging through resistors links capacitance to circuit theory
Coulomb's law and electric fields share the inverse-square form of gravitation
Charged particles experience both electric and magnetic forces in combined fields
The photon and quantum model leads into particle physics and radioactive decay
Radioactive tracers, PET and X-ray production all apply nuclear physics
Black-body radiation and ideal-gas ideas describe stars and the early universe
